description: User-provided original kit photographs recovered with foreground-only descriptor registration. Packaged JPEG bytes are identical to the supplied files; no cropping, retouching, rendering, or re-encoding was performed. Registration metadata restricts feature extraction, not source image contents.
limitations: Nominal dimensions support provisional pose only; these photos do not establish physical calibration.
Identity and visible face geometry do not establish attachment, shaft engagement, capacity, voltage suitability, wiring continuity, or polarity.
A same-source recognition check is registration regression coverage, not independent accuracy evidence.
Feature-region boundaries restrict descriptor centers; ORB patches can extend beyond a boundary. Background-only negatives therefore remain necessary.

images.review: The broad printed battery face is visible. The inset label polygon excludes the adjacent multicolor jumper bundle, terminal clip, leads, barrel plug, and desk. The 9 V example does not cover every permitted battery package.

Separate opposite printed label face. Promoted from evaluation to training after first-face-only failed to identify this different label. This is source registration coverage, not a held-out accuracy measurement.

images.featureMask: 32 narrow rubber annulus segments, an inset central hub ellipse, and five inset solid spoke polygons; exact vertices are authored in SalvagedPhysicalReferenceCatalog.
images.review: The complete yellow five-spoke wheel and rubber ring are visible. Desk texture through the five apertures is excluded. Its rotational symmetry cannot establish motor shaft direction or mechanical engagement. No distinct held-out photograph of this wheel is available.
